known_differences.description: minimize supports Nelder-Mead, BFGS, CG, Powell, L-BFGS-B, Newton-CG, TNC, SLSQP, COBYLA, dogleg, trust-ncg, trust-exact, trust-krylov, and trust-constr.

threats.description: Quasi-Newton and trust-region minimizers encountering non-finite objective or gradient evaluations during line search or subproblem steps.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/minimize.rs:516 (minimize_with_audit): validates initial state and objective finiteness, recording FailClosed on NaN/Inf.
threats.strict_mode_response: Propagate or terminate line search with ConvergenceWarning matching SciPy.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite x0 or objective values fail-closed with OptError::NonFiniteInput.

threats.description: Root-finding bracket endpoints [a, b] where f(a) and f(b) have the same sign or invalid xtol/rtol parameters.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/root.rs:121 (brentq): verifies opposite signs at bracket endpoints and positive tolerances before iterating.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject invalid bracket or non-finite endpoints fail-closed with audit event.

threats.description: Unbounded iteration or function evaluations on flat or oscillatory objectives in scalar bracket search.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/bracket.rs:160 (bracket_root): enforces maxiter bound and returns structured termination status when no bracket is found.
threats.strict_mode_response: Terminate at maxiter with converged=false matching SciPy elementwise.bracket_root.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Enforce strict evaluation cap and return non-converged result without looping.

threats.description: Linear programming simplex / interior-point status reporting on infeasible or unbounded polyhedra.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-opt/src/linprog.rs:204 (linprog): detects primal infeasibility and dual unboundedness and reports SciPy-compatible status codes.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Validate matrix dimensions and finiteness before simplex phase I.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: non-finite initial guess x0 or bounds
fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Reject empty x0; follow SciPy on NaN in Strict mode unless check_finite is set.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Reject non-finite x0 immediately with OptError::NonFiniteInput and FailClosed audit record.
Return OptError::SignChangeRequired and log FailClosed event.
Return OptError::InvalidArgument and log FailClosed event.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return OptimizeResult with success=false and status=MaxEvaluationsReached.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Terminate at budget cap and record outcome in CASP portfolio when active.
